steps.title: Bem-vindo: Culture - Volume 17
steps.text: In this A2-level lesson, we'll explore essential vocabulary and phrases about "Culture". Get ready to level up your real-world communication skills!

words.example: It's a tradition in my family to cook together on Sundays.
The music festival happens every summer.
This holiday is celebrated with fireworks.

steps.title: Idiom: Bite the bullet
steps.text: It means: "To face a difficult situation with courage.". Say the example sentence out loud:
steps.targetPhrase: I hate going to the dentist, but I'll just have to bite the bullet.
